The appellant herein is the petitioner in Crl.M.P.No.718 of 2017 on the file of Sessions Judge,
Special Court for Exclusive Trial of Cases Registered Under the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, Villupuram.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The appellant who has been charged for the alleged offences under Sections 294(b), 323, 324, 341, 354, 506(ii) and 376 read with 511 of The Indian Penal Code, 1860 read with Section 3(1)(w)(i), 3(2)(V) and 3(2)(Va) of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 filed the above petition under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, seeking bail before the Trial Court.

entities.text: Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The Trial Court in and by an order dated 12.06.2017 dismissed the said petition.
Feeling aggrieved with the said order, the appellant preferred this Criminal Appeal under Section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.

To be noted, though the present appeal has been filed under Section 374 Cr.P.C., it is really an appeal under Section 14-A of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes ( P r e v e n t i o n o f A t r o c i t i e s ) A c t , 1 9 8 9 ( h e r e i n a f t e r b e r e f e r r e d a s ' s a i d A c t ' ) .
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis CRL.A.NO.324 OF 2017 2.On perusal of records, it is seen that the appeal was filed on 16.06.2017 and notice was ordered on 19.06.2017.

On 17.07.2017, when the matter came before the Hon'ble Mr.Justice N.Authinathan, J.,
(as he then was) His Lordship allowed the appeal and thereby, granted bail to the appellant with the following conditions:
7.The petitioner is ordered to be enlarged on bail on his executing a bond for Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with two sureties each for a like sum to the satisfaction of Judicial Magistrate No.II, Tindivanam, Villupuram District, within a period of two weeks from the date of this order and on further condition that the petitioner shall stay at Madurai and report before the Inspector of Police,
Thallakulam Police Station, Madurai daily at 10.30 a.m., until further orders.
3.Subsequently, the appellant filed a petition in Crl.M.P.No.10150 of 2017 in the above appeal seeking modification of the condition.

Accordingly, the condition has been modified on 11.08.2017, which reads as follows:
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis CRL.A.NO.324 OF 2017 5....

Accordingly, the condition imposed by this Court in Crl.A.No.324 of 2017 dated 17.07.2017 is modified to the effect that the petitioner shall stay at Chennai and report before the Inspector of Police, B-1 North Beach Police Station, Chennai, daily at 9.00 a.m., until further orders.

entities.text: B-1 North Beach Police Station, Chennai
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The other conditions shall remain unaltered.

4.Thereafter, the appellant filed another petition in Crl.M.P.No.11298 of 2017 in the above appeal seeking to relax the condition imposed in the order dated 11.08.2017 in Crl.M.P.No.10150 of 2017 and the same was also allowed on 06.09.2017 and thereby modified the said condition.

Operative portion of the order dated 06.09.2017 reads as follows:
5.Having regard to the difficulties expressed by the petitioner, I am inclined to modify the condition.

Accordingly, the condition imposed by this Court in Saravanan @ Thulasi vs State Rep. By on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149409117/
2 Crl.M.P.No.10150 of 2017 in Crl.A.No.324 of 2017 dated 11.08.2017 is modified to the effect that the petitioner shall appear before the respondent police, daily at 9.00 a.m.,
until https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis CRL.A.NO.324 OF 2017 further orders.
5.The petitioner / appellant filed yet another petition in Crl.M.P.No.12939 of 2017 in the above appeal seeking to relax the modified condition imposed in the order dated 06.09.2017 passed in Crl.M.P.No.11298 of 2017 in Crl.M.P.No.10150 of 2017 in Crl.A.No.324 of 2017.

Operative portion of the order reads as follows:
5.Taking into consideration the nature of allegations in the first information report and the stage of investigation, the condition imposed on the petitioner to appear before the respondent police daily at 9.00 a.m until further orders is hereby relaxed.
However, the petitioner shall appear before the respondent police as and when required.
6 . T o d a y , M s . R . H e m a l a t h a , l e a r n e d c o u n s e l f o r t h e a p p e l l a n t a n d Mr.A.Gokulakrishnan, learned Additional Public Prosecutor are present.

7 . L e a r n e d A d d i t i o n a l P u b l i c P r o s e c u t o r f o r t h e r e s p o n d e n t https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis CRL.A.NO.324 OF 2017 brought to the notice of this Court that Crime No.352 of 2017 was taken on file in SC.No.11 of 2018 on the file of Special Court for Exclusive Trial of Cases registered under the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989, Villupuram

and the same was ended in conviction on 05.09.2022.
8.In view of the facts and circumstances of the cases, nothing survives for further adjudication in this Criminal Appeal as bail was already granted by this Court on 17.07.2017 and the conditions were totally relaxed as early as on 13.10.2017.
9.Registry is directed to not to list the Criminal Appeal any further.
